arguments.command:
cd /app/work && echo "=== examples ===" && for ex in ambiguity empty bad-type; do
  /app/submission/run.sh < /app/examples/$ex.json > /app/work/tmp/got_$ex.json 2>&1
  python3 -c "
import json,sys
got=json.load(open('/app/work/tmp/got_$ex.json')); exp=json.load(open('/app/examples/$ex.expected.json'))
def norm(r):
    if 'error' in r: return r
    cls = sorted((c['signature'], c['members'], sorted((l['atom'],l['negated']) for l in c['representative']['or'])) for c in r['classes'])
    qs = [(q['trace'],q['end'],q['must'],q['may'],q['status']) for q in r['queries']]
    return {'version':1,'classes':cls,'queries':qs}
print('$ex:', 'MATCH' if norm(got)==norm(exp) else 'MISMATCH got=%s exp=%s' % (got, exp))
"
done
